title: Cycle-Close Assessment of Maintenance and Paper Statement Fees on Savings Accounts
content:
A statement cycle of Savings & Money Market Accounts runs from the day after the previous cycle closing date through the cycle closing date, and the two periodic fees of this product are assessed at that close.

### The maintenance fee

At each statement cycle close the tier's monthly maintenance fee is assessed as one fee entry carrying the monthly maintenance fee code for that cycle, unless at least one waiver offered by the tier is met for the cycle. The tier used is the one recorded on the account at cycle close.

The maintenance fee is assessed only on an account whose status at cycle close is active. It is not assessed for the cycle in which the account was opened. At most one maintenance fee is assessed per account per statement cycle. A tier fee of 0.00 USD writes no entry.

### The waivers

The waivers are alternatives: any single one of them suffices, the fee is never prorated and never partially waived, and a waiver whose parameter for the tier reads not offered cannot be used at all.

| Waiver | What must hold for the cycle |
| --- | --- |
| Lowest end-of-day balance | The lowest end-of-day balance on any day of the cycle is at or above the tier's balance waiver figure |
| Automatic transfer | The total of automatic transfers from checking posted in the cycle is at or above the tier's automatic transfer waiver figure |
| Owner's age | The owner's age at cycle close is below the tier's age waiver figure |
| Linked checking | An active checking account of a tier listed among the tier's linked checking tiers is held by the same customer at cycle close |
| Relationship balance | The relationship balance at cycle close, taken on the basis the Personal Checking charter sets for it with mortgage principal excluded, is at or above the tier's relationship waiver figure |

Each of these is read from the bank's own records for the cycle; a customer's account of their balances or holdings does not stand in for them.

### The paper statement fee

When statement delivery is paper at cycle close, the tier's paper statement fee is assessed as a fee entry carrying the paper statement fee code for that cycle, except for owners who are at least the tier's exempt age at cycle close. A tier fee of 0.00 USD writes no entry.

### A point of judgement on the waivers

Because the waivers are alternatives, meeting two of them removes exactly the same one fee that meeting one of them removes; and because the fee is never partially waived, a cycle in which no offered waiver is met carries the tier's whole monthly maintenance fee, not a reduced part of it.
